# El Shams — Textile Dyeing, Printing & Finishing Factory (Egypt)

> El Shams is a textile mill in the 10th of Ramadan Industrial Zone, Sharkia, Egypt,
> running dyeing, prep printing, finishing and knitting. It processes cloth supplied
> by textile mills and ready-made garment manufacturers, and knits its own, serving
> customers in Egypt and exporting to Europe and the Middle East.

## Company facts

- Legal/trading name: El Shams (El Shams Dyeing, Printing & Finishing)
- Founded: 1981, by Mr Shawky Mokhtar — 45 years of continuous production
- Staff: 400+ across dyeing, printing, finishing, quality control and administration
- Address: 10th of Ramadan, Industrial Zone B1, Pace (4) IXA4, Sharkia, Egypt
- Coordinates: 30.279602, 31.722906
- Telephone (international): +20 106 671 3166
- CEO: +20 122 747 1032 / +20 122 935 1402
- CMO: +20 106 671 3166 / +20 120 204 6829
- Customer service: 01066713166 — Commercial office: 01055778831
- Email: Info@elshams.org
- Working languages: English and Arabic
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015 (quality), ISO 14001:2015 (environmental),
  ISO 45001:2018 (occupational health and safety)
- Areas served: Egypt, Europe, Middle East
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ElShamsTextiles
- Not to be confused with: El Shams SC (football club), El Shams Housing &
  Development, El Shams law firm, or any other unrelated business using the name.

## Capacity and machinery

- Dyeing capacity: 40+ tons per day
- Rotary printing capacity: 70,000 metres per day
- Knitting capacity: 20 tons per day
- Minimum order quantity: 250 kg per colour
- Lead time: depends on quantity and shade; a firm lead time and price normally
  come back within two working days of receiving a spec
- Dyeing machines: 15 total — 9 jet machines, 4 banana jets, 2 jiggers
- Printing line: 2 rotary printing machines, 1 steamer, 2 continuous washing machines
- Finishing line: 5 stenters (RAM), 2 closed compactors, 1 sanforizing machine,
  1 singeing machine, 2 raising machines, 1 shaving machine, 4 squeezers, 1 dryer,
  1 carbon finishing machine

## Services

- [Fabric dyeing](https://elshams.org/fabric-dyeing-egypt/): cotton, viscose,
  polyester and blends, matched to the customer's own pantone. Jets, banana jets,
  jiggers and continuous lines.
- [Textile printing](https://elshams.org/textile-printing-egypt/): rotary screen
  and digital pigment printing on prepared cloth.
- [Fabric finishing](https://elshams.org/fabric-finishing/): mechanical and
  chemical finishing — stenter setting, compacting and shrinkage control, checked
  against the customer's spec.
- Knitting: in-house knitted fabric production at 20 tons per day.
- [The factory](https://elshams.org/textile-manufacturer-egypt/): capabilities,
  certifications and how the mill operates.

## How the mill runs

Six stages, in order: intake and inspection → pre-treatment → dyeing → printing →
finishing → QC and dispatch. Customers can use a single stage or the whole line.
Every roll is inspected, graded and packed to destination spec. Buyers are welcome
to visit and to run the audits a European or Gulf customer would expect.

## Getting a quote

Send fibre, weight, quantity and target shade to the commercial office. El Shams
replies with a lead time and a price, usually within two working days.
Contact form: https://elshams.org/#contact
